messages:
Liam Coleman: Hey team — about ACME POC: they need strict EU data residency + BYO-KMS. Also want ability to prove egress origination (where traffic left our infra) for audit. Can Redwood tag traffic and route to EU-only subprocessors? cc @Priya N
Priya N (Solutions): Can you paste the customer's exact acceptance criteria? e.g., 'data and model inference must not leave EU, KMS keys in customer's account, only EU subprocessors allowed' etc
Liam Coleman: Yep — copied from SOW: "All inference requests, logs, and metadata must remain within EU regions; crypto keys must be customer-managed in EU, subprocessors must be EU-only or have EU-only regional processing agreement. We need audit logs showing egress region for each request." They also want a pricing delta if we do reserved capacity + BYO-KMS.
Tessa R (Eng): Short answer: we can pin model routing to EU regions and accept external KMS (BYOK) for Private & Dedicated. Need to confirm a few things: 1) do they want tenant pinning at region-level or per-request routing? 2) how strict is 'no cross-border fallback' (can we fallback to compat model in EU-other)?
ACME Eng - Javier: region-level pinning is fine, but no cross-border fallback. If we failover, must remain within EU and notify.
Priya N (Solutions): Got it — @Tessa R can we enforce no cross-border fallback in Dedicated? What about hosted? 
Tessa R (Eng): Dedicated yes (we manage GPU pools in EU only). Hosted API — we'd need a routing policy + subnet peering to guarantee (hosting team question). For hosted we can offer 'EU-only tenancy' if they take Dedicated or Private. 
DevOps Bot: deploy-checklist: BYO-KMS integration requires KMS endpoint whitelist + certificate exchange. See https://docs.redwood.com/private/byok
Elena (Legal): Also need subprocessors list and Data Processing Agreement addendum. Sales please request updated subprocessor attestations — finance/legal will need lead time.
Priya N (Solutions): Liam — I'll draft the POC checklist and include: routing policy sample, KMS flowchart, attestation ask, and pricing ask for reserved capacity + BYO-KMS integration support.
Liam Coleman: For routing policy sample, can you add a small example I can share? 
Tessa R (Eng): Sure — sample below:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: tenant_pin
  pinned_region: eu-west-1
  allowed_subprocessors:
    - aws:eu-west-1
    - gcp:europe-west1
  cross_border_fallback: false
  audit_headers: [x-rdwl-region, x-rdwl-egress]
```
Priya N (Solutions): Nice. Liam — for pricing, rough delta: +15% on top of hosted for EU-only + BYO-KMS integration one-time $5k setup for cert+attestation work. Can confirm with finance.
Liam Coleman: thanks. @Elena what turnaround for subprocessor attestation? 
Elena (Legal): We can produce the attestation within 3 business days if the customer signs NDA and provides list of endpoints.
ACME Eng - Javier: We'll start compiling endpoint list. Also curious about audit logs format — can we get a sample? 
Tessa R (Eng): yes — we emit request-level audit with header fields and region tag, sample in console export. I'll drop link in the doc Priya is building.
Priya N (Solutions): Action items: 1) Priya to send POC checklist + pricing by EOD 2) Tessa to confirm hosted EU-only feasibility and sample logs 3) Legal to prepare attestation template. @Liam can you coordinate with ACME for NDA and endpoints? :thumbsup:
Liam Coleman: on it. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
DevOps Bot: reminder: create ticket INF-4721 for BYO-KMS onboarding
